observations.body: Jerusalem, suffering, death, and resurrection are named before Peter responds.
observations.label: Announcement

observations.body: Peter takes Jesus aside and rebukes him with words of refusal.
observations.label: Private resistance

observations.body: Jesus answers Peter and then addresses all disciples about self-denial, cross, life, loss, and coming judgment.
observations.label: Public following

payload.posture: Keep the passion announcement, private rebuke, answer, and wider discipleship speech connected but distinct.
payload.tension: Peter’s resistance to the announced path is answered by language that places following on that same path.
payload.title: Peter rebukes and is rebuked
